# ghost/clock

Samsung Clock timer start/cancel/state and the Google Clock alarm/world-city/stopwatch toolkit. Timer app is auto-detected; Samsung actions never open alarms.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/clock
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/clock set_alarm --device <serial> --param hour=<hour> --param minute=<minute>
ghost skill run ghost/clock list_alarms --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/clock start_timer --device <serial> --param seconds=<seconds>
ghost skill run ghost/clock start_stopwatch --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/clock add_world_city --device <serial> --param city=<city>
ghost skill run ghost/clock cancel_timer --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/clock get_timer_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `set_alarm`: Set an alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning called Gym
- `list_alarms`: What alarms do I have set?
- `start_timer`: Start a 5 minute timer for tea
- `start_stopwatch`: Start the stopwatch
- `add_world_city`: Add Tokyo to my world clock
- `cancel_timer`: Cancel my Samsung timer
- `get_timer_state`: Is a Samsung timer active?
